offlineBakeFallback.reason: Installed Blender MCP file-targeted tool exposes only blend_file and code. Its internal run_blender_cli defaults to a hard 120-second subprocess timeout; the public tool exposes no timeout/environment override. Full atlas and UV receiver partition attempts exceeded that bound. No MCP installation was patched.
offlineBakeFallback.authorization: Root explained this concrete limitation to the user and authorized an offline bake-only fallback under the device MCP preference exception.
offlineBakeFallback.method: Fresh independent Blender background process per atlas, same immutable source and original recipe, serial GPU lock, 1800-second job timeout.
offlineBakeFallback.quality: 96 samples and original atlas dimensions. No receiver splitting, no float buffer assembly, no geometry/UV/material changes.
offlineBakeFallback.observedBottleneck: One-second read-only process stack sample found Cycles bake inside OpenImageDenoise CPU denoising. day-2 completed intact in 199.75 wall seconds.
